summary: Inspected the frozen-head package path only (deploy/install.sh, deploy/dynamite_autostart.sh, deploy/bind.conf, deploy/rule.conf, deploy/README.md, README.md, build.sh, Cargo.toml, tools/dictation/*, docs/restart-checklist.md; `git diff --stat eb40eee..abe9f5c4 -- deploy README.md build.sh Cargo.toml tools/dictation` is empty, so the lens files are the frozen head). Ran the real installer only against throwaway fake HOMEs (/tmp/fh*, /tmp/fhZ, /tmp/fhF, /tmp/fhT, /tmp/fhU, /tmp/livecfg): --check creates nothing and prints would-write lines (r2 claim holds); real run is idempotent on second pass; all modes 755; sh -n/bash -n clean on install.sh, dynamite_autostart.sh, dictation_supervisor.sh; rule.conf append and the generated dynamite-bind.conf both parse, and the owner's live config copy parses rc=0. The decisive negative: I used the real MangoWM parser as oracle (/usr/bin/mango 0.18.3, `mango -c <file> -p`, 3/3 deterministic) and the line deploy/install.sh:65 appends — `source <path>` — is rejected as `[ERROR]: Invalid line format: source /tmp/.../dynamite-bind.conf`, rc=1, while `source = <path>` is accepted rc=0; a sentinel-key test proves the space form never loads the included file at all (no `Unknown keyword:` sentinel) whereas `source = ...` does load it. So on a FRESH install neither SUPER+space nor SUPER+v exists, and the user's config emits a parse error. The dedup guard is inverted the same way: a correctly written `source = ...` line is duplicated with an invalid one (`diff` 2a3,4). Also verified: unknown flags are ignored and perform a real install (`--dry-run`, `--help` both wrote all four files, rc=0); the generated 187B `exec` wrapper replaces (no backup) the owner's 9616B restarting supervisor on 'differs — replacing'; dictation has no documented way to be started (0 mentions of supervisor/api_key in README.md and deploy/README.md; only `tools/dictation/EMBEDDING.md:52` and the owner's private autostart.sh:74-75); cold-cache offline reality is only honest in a dev note and one build.sh comment while docs/restart-checklist.md instructs exactly the failing `cargo build --release --offline`; and two user-facing sentences name a protocol that does not exist. NOT verified, and not credited: no fresh clone, no cold-CARGO_HOME build (cargo metadata --offline tests only, and `--offline` itself failed rc=101 for both crates unless target-filtered or fully populated), no live installer against the real HOME, no compositor reload with a bad line beyond `-p`, the generated wrapper was never executed, no dictation runtime, no full `cargo test`. Verdict: a fresh user following these docs gets a panel that runs but cannot be triggered by hotkey, a config parser error, and a dictation feature that is built and never started — not shippable under this lens.

findings.title: Installer writes a MangoWM-invalid `source` line, so fresh-install hotkeys never bind
findings.detail: deploy/install.sh:65 appends `printf '\nsource %s\n' "$BINDS"` — the space form. The shipped parser rejects it: `mango -c /tmp/fhE/t.conf -p` (parent containing exactly the installer's line plus `source = .../dynamite-bind.conf`) prints `[ERROR]: Invalid line format: source /tmp/fhE/home/.config/mango/dynamite-bind.conf` with `╰─[Index] .../bind.conf:3` and exits 1, reproduced 3/3; the same file written as `source = <path>` parses rc=0. Mechanism proven by sentinel: with `sentinel_inside_binds=1` in dynamite-bind.conf, the space form produces the Invalid-line error and never loads the file, while the `source =` form produces `Unknown keyword: sentinel_inside_binds` (file loaded). Counterexample/severity: the owner's live machine works only because the line was hand-written correctly (`~/.config/mango/config.conf:127-131` uses `source = ./bind.conf`), so this defect is invisible in the demo and 100% fatal for the new user this lens exists to judge — the two spawn bindings (`bind=SUPER,space`, `bind=SUPER,v`) silently never exist. Fix: append `source = %s` (and only that form) at deploy/install.sh:65, and add a `mango -p`-style parse check or at least an assertion in deploy/install.sh that the written line matches `^source = `.

findings.title: Include dedup guard matches the wrong form, so a correct bind.conf gains a duplicate invalid line
findings.detail: deploy/install.sh:60-61 greps `-qxF "source $BINDS"` / `"source $BINDS_TILDE"` — i.e. it detects the space form Mango rejects and is blind to the equals form Mango accepts. Reproduced: /tmp/fhF pre-seeded with the correct `source = /tmp/fhF/home/.config/mango/dynamite-bind.conf` → output `append source line to bind.conf`, `diff` shows `2a3,4` and the file ends up with a valid line plus a second invalid one (1 Invalid-line error on parse); same for the tilde variant in /tmp/fhT. This is the common case for anyone who followed the repo's own hand-install instructions or a previous fixed run, and it silently degrades a working config. Fix: grep for `^source = <path>$` (and the tilde equivalent), treat any existing `source`/`source =`/`source=` mention of that path as present, per the dedup fix above.

findings.title: Cold-cache offline build fails for BOTH crates, but the docs claim/require it
findings.detail: Resolution evidence (safe, no builds): `cargo metadata --offline` in the panel root exits 101 with `failed to download 'hermit-abi v0.5.3' / attempting to make an HTTP request, but --offline was specified`, dictation exits 101 on `cesu8 v1.1.0`; `cargo fetch --offline` fails on `windows-sys v0.61.2` for both; with a fresh CARGO_HOME the panel fails with `error: no matching package named 'fontdue' found`. Only `--filter-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` gives rc=0, i.e. offline works only because the warm registry holds foreign-target crates — the vendored `png` (Cargo.toml:22-30) does not make the panel cold-cache buildable. Meanwhile docs/restart-checklist.md step 2 instructs `cargo build --release --offline` verbatim, and the honest limitation is buried in tools/dictation/EMBEDDING.md and the comment at build.sh:20-21 while README.md's Build section says nothing. Fix: state in README.md (Build) that first build requires network (or `--filter-platform`/vendored index) for both crates, and correct docs/restart-checklist.md step 2 to a command that actually works on a cold cache.

findings.title: Installer replaces the owner's restarting supervisor with a one-shot exec wrapper, no backup
findings.detail: deploy/install.sh:80-87 writes a 187-byte wrapper ending `exec "$HERE/deploy/dynamite_autostart.sh"` and chmods 755; the machine's real `~/.config/mango/scripts/dynamite_autostart.sh` is a 9616-byte supervisor with a crash restart loop, give-up cap (line ~198) and `~/.cache/dynamite.log`. Reproduced on a fake HOME seeded with a 9616-byte hand-written wrapper: stdout says only `differs — replacing` and the file is overwritten, no backup taken, so the user loses restart-on-crash and all logging with one word of warning — while the same script deliberately never overwrites bind.conf/rule.conf. The comment at deploy/install.sh:33-34 claims a second run does not rewrite a hand-edited wrapper, which the code contradicts. Fix: write the wrapper only if absent, otherwise print the desired content and skip (or save `<file>.bak-<n>`), and say in deploy/README.md:26-28 that the generated wrapper does not restart the panel.

findings.title: Dictation is buildable but nothing documents how to start it (or set the key) on a fresh install
findings.detail: grep for `dictation_supervisor` outside docs/ and COUNCIL_LOG.md matches only `tools/dictation/EMBEDDING.md:52`; README.md has zero occurrences of `supervisor` and zero of `api_key`, deploy/README.md likewise (its Dictation section, lines 50-59, only covers `/dev/uinput` and `usermod -aG input`). The binary exists (tools/dictation/target/release/static-dictation, 3.3M, 755) and the hotkey lives inside it, so a fresh user builds dictation, gets no running process, and Super+D does nothing; if they do start it by hand, missing `~/.config/static-dictation/api_key` makes it `exit(1)` at tools/dictation/src/config.rs:14-40 with no fix path in the top-level docs. Only the owner's private `~/.config/mango/autostart.sh:74-75` starts it. Fix: add an autostart line (or documented command) for tools/dictation/scripts/dictation_supervisor.sh plus the api_key creation step to README.md/deploy/README.md.

findings.title: Unknown installer flags silently perform a real install
findings.detail: deploy/install.sh:18-19 accept only the literal `--check`; anything else falls through to the writing path. Verified on fake HOME /tmp/fhU: `./deploy/install.sh --dry-run` and `./deploy/install.sh --help` both exit 0 and write dynamite-bind.conf, bind.conf, rule.conf and the wrapper (`find` enumerated all four). A user guessing a no-op flag mutates their compositor config. Fix: `case "${1:-}" in "") ;; --check) CHECK=1 ;; *) echo "usage: $0 [--check]"; exit 2 ;; esac`.

findings.title: Hand-install reference snippet reproduces the invalid include form
findings.detail: deploy/bind.conf:13-16 documents `grep -qxF 'source ~/.config/mango/dynamite-bind.conf' ... || echo 'source ~/.config/mango/dynamite-bind.conf' >> ...` — the space form again — so the by-hand path in deploy/README.md:24 lands users in the same broken state, and the dedup guard then wrongly reports it as sourced. Fix: update the snippet to `source = ~/.config/mango/dynamite-bind.conf`.

findings.title: Two user-facing sentences name a protocol that does not exist
findings.detail: README.md:28 and README.md:161 (and deploy/README.md:66-69) contain the literal `ext-session-lock-v1` (verified by code-point dump and `grep -Fn`; 7 more hits in docs/mango-capabilities.md, 1 in docs/transcript-dim-session.md) where the real name `ext-session-lock-v1`-class identifier appears elsewhere in README.md. The security disclaimers themselves are accurate ('not a security boundary'), but the fresh-install doc sends a reader searching for a protocol that does not exist. Fix: replace with the real protocol name in those three sentences.

what_would_make_it_a_10: Make deploy/install.sh emit `source = <abs path>` (and match the same form when deduping, plus a post-write `mango -c ... -p` sanity assertion), so a fresh install actually binds SUPER+space/SUPER+v; refuse unknown flags; never overwrite a hand-edited wrapper and document that the generated one does not restart the panel; document the dictation supervisor + api_key + `input`/uinput steps end-to-end in README.md and deploy/README.md; state the real cold-cache/offline build requirement in README.md Build and fix docs/restart-checklist.md step 2; and correct the mangled protocol id. Then re-run my fake-HOME sequence and one `mango -c` parse of the resulting bind.conf as the acceptance gate — with that evidence plus a successful fresh-clone build I would ship this under the packaging lens.
